title: Appointment calendar
subtitle: Your schedule, at a glance
loadError: Unable to load the schedule. Please try again.
emptyHint: Choose another date or adjust your filters.
copyError: Copy the link from your address bar to share this view.
shareHint: This link shares filters only. Each person sees only their own appointments.
cancelHint: The appointment will be cancelled and its time slot released.
reasonPlaceholder: Explain the change to the patient
noSlots: No available slots with the same duration. Update your availability or refresh.
editHint: Future scheduled appointments can be moved to an available slot. Follow-ups retain their documented schedule.
dragHint: Drag a scheduled appointment onto an available slot, or open it and choose Reschedule.
patientHint: This calendar shows your appointments only. Empty space does not indicate a doctor's availability.
mobileHint: Appointments are grouped by day on smaller screens.
invalidDrop: Choose an available slot with the same duration.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to change this appointment.
errors.INVALID_REQUEST: Check the time slot and enter a reason (up to 500 characters).
errors.STALE_APPOINTMENT: This appointment changed elsewhere. Review the latest schedule and try again.
errors.NOT_EDITABLE: This appointment can no longer be rescheduled.
errors.SLOT_UNAVAILABLE: This time is no longer available, or the patient has another appointment. Choose another slot.
errors.TRANSACTIONS_REQUIRED: Rescheduling is temporarily unavailable. Please contact the clinic.
errors.SAVE_FAILED: The change could not be saved. Refresh the schedule before trying again.
errors.LOAD_FAILED: Available slots could not be loaded. Please refresh.
